findings.current: Internal energy surged from my dantian and coursed through my entire body.
findings.defect: The generic phrase “entire body” omits the source’s specific image of internal energy spreading through the limbs and bones.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly uses 사지백해, a Murim anatomical expression referring to the limbs and bones throughout the body; the accepted baseline preserved that physical detail.
findings.replacement: Internal energy surged from my dantian and coursed through my limbs and bones.

summary: Faithful overall, with one minor loss of source-specific martial-arts anatomy.
